verdict.rationale: The evidence shows many individual SKILL.md files (review, qa, ship, cso, etc.) but no documented template, schema, or guide describing the SKILL.md frontmatter fields (name/description) for authoring a *new* skill; a developer would have to reverse-engineer conventions from these existing files rather than follow a stated template. missing for 10: a documented SKILL.md authoring template/spec, frontmatter field reference, and any 'create-skill' tooling or scaffold command.
